newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian April merchandise imports A$6.767 bln.
newsitem.headline: Australian April merchandise imports A$6.767 bln.

text.p: Australia's international merchandise imports stood at A$6.767 billion in April from a reported A$5.991 billion in March, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said.

This measure is compiled from information submitted by importers or their agents to the Australian Customs Service. It is not seasonally adjusted nor is it reported on the same balance-of-payments basis as monthly current account data.
